summary: Justin Perea asked Claude Opus 5.5 to demonstrate its full capabilities with zero external direction. Over a multi-hour session, the model generated a single 280 KB self-contained HTML file rendering complex procedural GLSL shaders and synthesized audio without any external libraries or assets.
summaryEn: Ex Nihilo: Pure HTML/GLSL Demoscene Intro by Claude Opus 5.5

post.originalText:
I asked Claude Opus 5.5 to make the most impressive demo of itself and gave it zero direction.

~5 hours and 697M tokens later, it made this demoscene intro. Every pixel and every sound comes from one 280 KB HTML file. No images, audio files, 3D models, or libraries.

Sound on.

(It also wrote this tweet)

sourceMaterials.text: @John4ZX4 ChatGPT has an image model and Claude is using code to create those so GPT has the advantage there 😅
